registration.scope: Previously exposed 12-galaxy development data, not independent confirmation.
registration.target: Half absolute velocity difference at diametrically opposite sky locations after intensity-weighted smoothing to a circular 20 arcsec Gaussian sigma. Cancels systemic velocity; measures odd LOS motion, not total circular acceleration.
registration.source: Actual HI MOM0 intensity; beam corrected to circular sigma 20,40,80 arcsec. Added broad/local log intensity contrasts and opposite-side log intensity asymmetry.
registration.baseline: Published SPARC source components -> nominal RAR circular speed -> photometric or published kinematic projection -> intensity-weighted smoothing; no rotation-curve velocities used as predictors.
registration.local_stellar_input: Squared stellar-disk force-component speed from published source decomposition; no new SPARC velocity targets opened for scoring. Complete 12-object surface-brightness supplement is unavailable, so no placeholder brightness is inserted.
registration.mask: Nonzero finite MOM0; MOM1 finite nonzero; Gaussian support local>.98, 80 arcsec>.75, velocity support>.98; reference projected speed>10 km/s; source radial support>.98; absolute cos(theta)>.5. Both sides required.
registration.sampling: Fixed 20-pixel grid, one side of each opposite pair, minimum 10 pairs per galaxy; whole galaxies hold out, not pixels. Geometry scenarios reuse the common admitted grid across all scenarios and both products.
registration.validation: Leave one galaxy out; three inner whole-galaxy folds select parameters. No target-galaxy nuisance fitting.
limitations: MOM2 is gas velocity spread, not an error bar; no chi-square or noise-calibrated significance.
Opposite-pair motion can include noncircular flows, warps and asymmetric profiles.
Seven-object metadata include kinematically inferred geometry; predictions are conditional on those published values.
Standard intensity-weighted convolution of released moments is an approximation to full cube forward modeling.
Shared observations and masks make natural/robust agreement a processing check, not independent replication.
Coverage cuts define detected gas; no physical void or unique 3D reconstruction is inferred.
